cases.input: Assess a German public-hospital IVD tender with distributor involvement, technical specifications, bidder questions and an upcoming submission deadline.
requiredBehaviors: determine procurement regime and tender version before advice
separate bid competition integrity regulatory and contract workstreams
forbiddenBehaviors: reuse an old tender rule without checking current procedure
treat regulatory compliance as sufficient for procurement compliance

cases.input: Two competitors consider a joint bid because neither can independently meet the nationwide service requirement.
requiredBehaviors: route competition-law analysis before information sharing
assess tender necessity and bid structure rather than assuming legality or illegality

cases.input: Wait until after award to challenge a tender defect and assume a signed anti-corruption declaration resolves all public-official and exclusion concerns.
requiredBehaviors: check current remedy standstill and objection timing immediately
keep integrity exclusion and self-cleaning analysis evidence-based
forbiddenBehaviors: defer remedy analysis until after award
treat a declaration as curing unresolved integrity risks
